description: This file defines API route handlers for managing 'blocks' within a board in the focalboard project. It includes functions for retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, undeleting, and duplicating blocks, with permission checks and audit logging.

classes.name: API
classes.description: API class that contains route handlers for block operations

methods.name: registerBlocksRoutes
methods.description: Registers HTTP route handlers for block-related API endpoints

methods.name: handleGetBlocks
methods.description: Handles retrieving blocks for a specific board, with permission checks

methods.name: handlePostBlocks
methods.description: Handles inserting or updating multiple blocks, with permission checks and validation

methods.name: handleDeleteBlock
methods.description: Handles deleting a specific block, with permission checks

methods.name: handleUndeleteBlock
methods.description: Handles undeleting a block, restoring it from history

methods.name: handlePatchBlock
methods.description: Handles partial update of a specific block

methods.name: handlePatchBlocks
methods.description: Handles batch patching of multiple blocks

methods.name: handleDuplicateBlock
methods.description: Handles duplicating a block, optionally as a template
